## Professional Summary

Aafaque Nazir is a freelance full-stack web developer based in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. He builds production-grade websites, custom e-commerce stores, and scalable full-stack web applications for startups, businesses, and remote clients globally.

He specializes in modern frontend architectures (React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS) paired with robust backend services and databases (Node.js, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Firebase, MongoDB). His focus is on clean component design, fast load times, accessibility, and high conversion UX.

## Core Services

### 1. Websites & Landing Pages
- Custom responsive websites and landing pages built from scratch with React and Next.js.
- Micro-interactions, smooth scroll transitions, and subtle animations using Framer Motion.
- Clean SEO best practices, semantic markup, and Open Graph metadata for organic search visibility.
- Fast performance, responsive on mobile phones, tablets, and desktops.

### 2. Custom Online Stores (E-Commerce)
- Bespoke e-commerce storefronts tailored for brands and local businesses.
- Fast product catalogs, category filtering, cart management, and streamlined checkout flows.
- Direct WhatsApp ordering integration for direct customer engagement.
- Payment gateway integration capabilities (Razorpay, Stripe, etc.).

### 3. Custom Web Applications & SaaS
- Full-stack web applications, business dashboards, and management software.
- Real-time data synchronization using Supabase WebSockets.
- User authentication, role-based access, and secure database architecture.
- Modular REST and GraphQL APIs.
